map.日排放量 = 流量(m³/h) × 运行小时数；年排放量 = 日排放量 × 年运: Daily discharge = flow (m³/h) × operating hours; annual discharge = daily discharge × annual operating days; pollutant load (kg) = concentration (mg/L) × volume (m³) / 1000
map.单位换算：1 m³ = 1000 L，浓度 mg/L × 1000 L = 10: Unit conversion: 1 m³ = 1000 L, so concentration mg/L × 1000 L = 1000 mg = 1 g, hence kg = mg/L × m³ / 1000. The six indicators COD, BOD₅, ammonia nitrogen, total phosphorus, suspended solids and total nitrogen are each converted by the above formula into daily discharge and annual total load, for reference in corporate compliance, discharge permits and total-load accounting; results are not a basis for monitoring reports.
map.排放核算：录入流量与浓度，求 COD/氨氮等年排放量。: Discharge accounting: enter flow and concentration to get annual loads of COD, ammonia nitrogen and more.
map.许可比对：对比许可排放量，判断是否超总量。: Permit comparison: compare against permitted discharge to judge whether the total cap is exceeded.
map.教学演示：演示流量×浓度得负荷。: Teaching demo: show that flow × concentration gives the load.
